lines.text: Have you ever wondered how a single beam of white light can transform into seven beautiful colours?
When white light passes through a glass prism, it bends due to refraction.
But something extraordinary happens. The white light separates into seven different colours. This phenomenon is called dispersion of light.
Different colours bend by different amounts. Violet deviates the most, while red deviates the least.
And that is how a simple beam of white light reveals the colourful science hidden within it. Welcome to the world of physics!
